name: raking_hard
title: 斜扫硬光
what: A small, far source almost level with the object from the side: every relief, crack and tool mark throws a shadow. A weak soft fill from the camera side keeps the shadows from going black.

look_target.note: a reference film: a look target for the light only, never material truth

shots.what: wood end grain: a low warm light from the left, cracks and rings in relief, dark background
carved red lacquer: light raking from the upper left, the carving in sharp relief
silver repousse: hard light across the relief

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: rake
lamps.why: hard: 0.4 R across at 15 R, 1.5 degrees as seen from the object

lamps.name: fill
lamps.why: soft fill from the camera side, four stops under

backdrop.why: the default ground; a recipe sets the colour for its object (backdrop.material). Black flock (0.003): S3, framed as the film the ground in view is the floor just behind the object, lit by the same lamps; black velvet (0.01) came out dark grey there
